title: Aunt Sue
description: Identify the right Aunt Sue from 500 candidates using MFCSAM readings.
writeup:
## Approach

A simple filtering problem. Each Aunt Sue has 3 known properties out of 10. We check which Sue's known properties are consistent with the MFCSAM readings.

## Part 1

For each Sue, verify that every listed property matches the expected value exactly. Unknown properties are ignored (they could be anything). Exactly one Sue passes all checks.

## Part 2

The MFCSAM has outdated calibration: `cats` and `trees` readings indicate "greater than", while `pomeranians` and `goldfish` indicate "fewer than". All other properties still require exact matches. Apply these adjusted comparisons to find the real Sue.
